Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable AssetsAt PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.Your responsibilities include:- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.What you Bring and your QualitiesWe expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.Experience the Highest Degree of InvolvementPEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. SCHOTTEL France S.A.R.L. is the French subsidiary of SCHOTTEL GmbH, one of the world's leading manufacturers of propulsion and manoeuvring solutions for the maritime industry. With a strong focus on customer proximity and lifecycle support, SCHOTTEL France delivers complete propulsion solutions for newbuild and retrofit projects, including engineering, technical consulting and project management. decision-making paths Attractive compensation and benefits package with long-term career perspective within a stable and successful group Your key responsibilities include: Overall management of environment Strategic thinker with hands-on mentality   A BOOST FOR CAREERS | SCHOTTEL.DE Have we sparked your interest?
